claims.text: Armenia vs Liberia: Women in Secondary Teaching

claims.text: A global look at the percentage of female secondary school teachers, comparing Armenia and Liberia using World Bank data.
claims.support: Armenia and Liberia percentages from World Bank data

claims.text: In Armenia, 88.7% of secondary teachers are women. In Liberia, it's just 6.7%.
Armenia is the world's highest, with female teachers dominating high school classrooms.
Liberia sits at the world's lowest, where male teachers make up almost the entire workforce.
Armenia has 13 times the share of female secondary teachers Liberia has.
Most nations sit in between: Germany has 63.9%, USA has 62.8%, China has 60.3%, and India has 49.3%.
What share of secondary teachers in your country are women?
